subject: asp-es
title: ASP.ES.------SPT.D.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-12 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One), first of two on book p84, paired with v2-p84-2. Opens Braxton's transfer-cycles analysis: 'the concept of transfer cycles can be viewed with respect to the nature underlying how information is passed through various time zones and culture groups.' (C)ASP-ES (the concept of aspect essence) is crossed with SPT-D: the question is what aspect-essence produces when crossed with SPT-D — aspect-essence being the perceptual-extraction layer through which transfer-cycles operate. The rest of the chart descends as one chain from the main line: S-ST (source shift (progressionalism) manipulation) branches from it and leads to (R)TM (the reality of terminology—or terms of a definition), then to PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and ALT-D (alternative definitions). ALT-D carries CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) and, by the chart's only *dashed* line, AFN (affinity negation); in Braxton's legend a dotted line amplifies some aspect of the main concept it is connected to.
